y-m-18-01.s.s1.hint.1: Pachirevo chega chega, yedza rimwe nerimwe kana unogona kugadzira seti yemarekodhi isingaenderani nacho.
y-m-18-01.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvinoshandisa hukama hwokuti huwandu hwemarekodhi hunosarudzwa neavhareji nehuwandu hwevanhu.
y-m-18-01.s.s1.o.b: Vadzidzi vose 5 vakaita 8 kana kupfuura, uye hapana mudzidzi akaita shoma pane izvozvo.
y-m-18-01.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange neavhareji ye 10, mudzidzi mumwe anogona kuva norekodhi yakaderera zvikuru se 2. Unogona kunge wakatora avhareji se ‘mufananidzo wemudzidzi wose.’
y-m-18-01.s.s1.o.c: Kana mudzidzi akaita zvishoma pa 10, pane mumwe akaita zvakawanda.
y-m-18-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakaona kuti avhareji ndiyo poinzi yokuenzanisa apo divi riri pasi pa 10 nedivi riri pamusoro pa 10 zvinodzoreredzana.
y-m-18-01.s.s1.o.d: Pakati pevadzidzi 5, mudzidzi mumwe kana kupfuura akaita chaizvo nguva 10.
y-m-18-01.s.s1.r.d: Avhareji inogona kuva kukosha kwakasina munhu akaita chaizvo. Kunyange huwandu huri 50, se 8, 9, 11, 11, 11, hapana mudzidzi angave akaita 10.
y-m-18-01.s.s1.explain: Huwandu hwemarekodhi evadzidzi 5 ane avhareji ye 10 hunofanira kuva 50, uye kana mudzidzi akaita zvishoma pa 10, pane mudzidzi akaita zvakawanda pa 10 kuzadzisa kushaya uku. Asi haugoni kuti vose vakaita 8 kana kupfuura kana kuti mudzidzi mumwe akaita 10 zvirokwazvo.
y-m-18-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira seti 2 dzakasiyana dzemarekodhi eGroup B ane avhareji ye 10 umo marekodhi emudzidzi akaita zvakawanda zvikuru nomudzidzi akaita zvishoma zvikuru anosiyana ne 12 kana kupfuura. (Marekodhi evadzidzi 5 ndi a, b, c, d, e. Marekodhi anongochinja nhevedzano yevanhu anoverengwa serekodhi imwe chete.)

y-m-18-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza mudzidzi mumwe akaita zvishoma zvikuru, uye ufunge kuti ndiani angazadzisa kushaya uku.
y-m-18-01.s.s2.hint.2: Bvisa kukosha kukuru zvikuru nokudiki zvikuru kwemarekodhi awakagadzira pachako uye utarise kuti musiyano ndi 12 kana kupfuura.

y-m-18-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here zvakananga zvaunoda kutarisa kunze kweavhareji (rekodhi yakaderera zvikuru, rekodhi yakakwirira zvikuru, musiyano wemarekodhi, nezvimwewo)?
y-m-18-01.s.s3.model.0: Zvakaoma kubvuma. A yakaungana pa 8 kusvika 12, asi 2, 4, 10, 16, ne 18 zvandakagadzira zvine musiyano mukuru kubva pa 2 kusvika pa 18. Kunyange neavhareji imwe chete, kuti marekodhi akapararira zvakadini kwakasiyana, saka ndingada kuziva rekodhi yakakwirira zvikuru nedikiti zvikuru.
y-m-18-01.s.s3.model.1: Neavhareji oga zvakafanana, asi muB yandakagadzira, mudzidzi mumwe akaita 2 chete uye mumwe akaita 18, saka musiyano wesimba mukuru. Zvakaoma kuti vose vanoita zvakaenzana zvakanaka. Ndingada kuona rekodhi yomudzidzi mumwe nomumwe.

y-m-18-02.title: Kana ukabhadharira mari mbiri, zvipi zvinobuda kazhinji?
y-m-18-02.goal: Enzanisa tsananguro mbiri (mhedzisiro dzose tatu dzakafanana / tarisa mari yega yega zvakasiyana uye uparadzanise kuva nyaya) nedata yemuedzo, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye utaure kuti sei tichiparadzanisa kuva nyaya.
y-m-18-02.material:
Unobhadharira mari tsvuku nemari bhuruu panguva imwe chete. Mari yega yega ine mukana wakaenzana wehead netail, uye mari imwe haikanganisi imwe.
Jia: “Pane mhedzisiro nhatu: [dzose head], [head imwe netail imwe], uye [dzose tail], saka dzose dzine mukana wakaenzana.”
Minho: “Pane mari mbiri, saka tinofanira kuona kuti mari yega yega inobuda sei zvakasiyana.”
y-m-18-02.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga nokuvimba mushure mokuona data
y-m-18-02.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti sei tichiverenga nyaya zvakasiyana
y-m-18-02.prereq.0: Kutaura mukana se ‘wakafanana / wakakwirira / wakaderera’ (nhanho yeGiredhi 3 kusvika 5)
y-m-18-02.s.s1.prompt: Kana mari mbiri dzabhadharirwa, ndezvipi zvinotevera zvaunofunga kuti zvichabuda kazhinji? Sarudza pfungwa yaunayo ikozvino.
y-m-18-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti mari bhuruu inogona kuratidza divi ripi kana mari tsvuku iri head.
y-m-18-02.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora nenzira imwe chete kana mari tsvuku iri tail, uye uverenge kuti pane nzira dzingani zvose.
y-m-18-02.s.s1.r.a: Funga kana paine chikonzero chokuti ‘dzose head’ dzibude kazhinji zvakanyanya. Mari yega yega ine mukana wakaenzana wehead.
y-m-18-02.s.s1.o.b: Mhedzisiro dzose nhatu dzinobuda nenguva dzakangofanana
y-m-18-02.s.s1.r.b: Iyi ndiyo tsananguro inotora mhedzisiro dzakaparadzanwa kuva marudzi matatu sedzine mukana wakaenzana. Haisati yatarisa kana huwandu hwenzira dzinogona kuitika mhedzisiro yega yega hwakafanana.
y-m-18-02.s.s1.r.c: Uri kutarisa kana pane nzira dzakawanda dzokugadzira mhedzisiro iyoyo. Unogona kuyedza kuti humbowo ihwo hupi pachikamu chinotevera.
y-m-18-02.s.s1.r.d: Kubhadharira inzira yakanakawo, asi unogonawo kuigadzirisa pakutanga uchishandisa chokwadi chokuti pane mari mbiri.
y-m-18-02.s.s1.explain: Pachikamu ichi kufungidzira kwekutanga. Kufungidzira kwokuti ‘mhedzisiro nhatu dzakafanana’ kwakajairikawo, asi tichakuyedza nedata nokugadzirisa nyaya pazvikamu zvinotevera.
y-m-18-02.s.s1.acc.0: Izvi zvinonzwisisika sekufungidzira kwekutanga. Asi kuti ‘mhedzisiro nhatu’ dzine mukana wakaenzana here zvinofanira kuyedzwa, saka ngatitarisei data pachikamu chinotevera.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.prompt: Iri rekodhi rokubhadharira mari mbiri nguva 40. Dzose head nguva 9, head imwe netail imwe nguva 21, uye dzose tail nguva 10. Unotonga sei tsananguro yaJia kubva pamarekodhi aya?
y-m-18-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kana tsananguro yaJia yakarurama, fungidzira kuti mhedzisiro nhatu dzose dzinofanira kubuda nguva dzingani nokuparadzanisa 40.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.hint.1: Iise padivi pemarekodhi chaiwo 9, 21, ne 10 uye uenzanise kuti mhedzisiro ipi inosiyana nehuwandu hupi.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.o.a: Tsananguro yokuti mhedzisiro nhatu dzakafanana yakarurama, uye 21 yakangobuda nguva zhinji nemukana.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.r.a: Uri kuisa data pamukana. Kana mhedzisiro nhatu dzaiva dzakafanana, zvaizova zvakajairika kuti imwe neimwe ibude nguva 13 kubva pa 40; kuwana 21 kunoitika kazhinji sei?
y-m-18-02.s.s2.o.b: Mari hadzina kunaka, saka head imwe netail imwe yakabuda kazhinji.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.r.b: Mamiriro akati mari yega yega ine mukana wakaenzana wehead netail. Usati wapa mari mhosva, tanga watarisa kuti mhedzisiro inoverengwa sei.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.o.c: 40 idiki, saka hapana kutonga kunogona kuitwa kubva pamarekodhi aya.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.r.c: Ichokwadi kuti huwandu hwokubhadharira hushoma, asi musiyano pakati pe 21 ne 9 mukuru zvakanyanya. Kunyange usingakwanisi kuva nechokwadi, unogona kuenzanisa kana tsananguro inowirirana nedata.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.o.d: ‘Imwe neimwe’ yakabuda nguva dzinenge kaviri kupfuura dzimwe, saka tsananguro yaJia inonetsa kuvimba.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.r.d: Wakaenzanisa kana tsananguro inowirirana nedata nokutarisa reshiyo yehuwandu (9:21:10). Kubhadharira nguva 40 hahusi huwandu hukuru, saka kutaura kuti ‘inonetsa kuvimba’ kunokodzera.
y-m-18-02.s.s2.explain: Kana mhedzisiro nhatu dzaiva dzakafanana, sepatsananguro yaJia, imwe neimwe yaifanira kubuda nguva dzinenge 13 kubva pa 40, asi ‘imwe neimwe’ yakabuda nguva 21, dzinenge kaviri kupfuura dzimwe. Kubhadharira nguva 40 hakusi kwakawanda saka hatigoni kuva nechokwadi, asi tsananguro yaJia haienderane zvakanaka nedata.
y-m-18-02.s.s3.prompt: Ikozvino tsanangura kuti Jia anzwisise. Nyora mhedzisiro dzinogoneka uchiparadzanisa mari mbiri, uye unyore kuti sei ‘head imwe netail imwe’ inobuda kazhinji kupfuura ‘dzose head.’
y-m-18-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora sokunge uri kudhirowa tafura, uchiparadzanisa kana mari tsvuku iri head nekana iri tail.
y-m-18-02.s.s3.hint.1: Pakati penyaya dzawakanyora, cherechedza dzinoverengwa se ‘imwe neimwe.’
y-m-18-02.s.s3.placeholder: muenzaniso: Kana tikaparadzanisa mari tsvuku nemari bhuruu ...
y-m-18-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here nyaya dzose dzinogoneka pasina kusiya, uchiparadzanisa mari tsvuku nemari bhuruu?
y-m-18-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here zvakajeka kuti nyaya dzingani dzinoita ‘head imwe netail imwe’?
y-m-18-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakaratidza here pakanganisa ‘pane nhatu, saka dzakafanana’ yaJia?
y-m-18-02.s.s3.model.0: Kana tikaparadzanisa mari tsvuku nemari bhuruu, pane nyaya 4: (head, head), (head, tail), (tail, head), (tail, tail). Pakati pedzi, ‘imwe neimwe’ ndidzo nyaya mbiri (head, tail) ne (tail, head), saka inobuda kaviri kupfuura ‘dzose head.’
y-m-18-02.s.s3.model.1: Mari mbiri dzakasiyana, saka (tsvuku head, bhuruu tail) ne (tsvuku tail, bhuruu head) inyaya dzakasiyana. Nyaya 2 pa 4 ndedzenzira ‘imwe neimwe,’ saka mukana ndi 1/2, uye dzose head ndi 1/4.

y-m-18-04.title: Kana bhawa rimwe riri kaviri kukwira, mitengo yekutengesa inokuwo kaviri here?
y-m-18-04.goal: Ziva kuti mu bar graph ine scale isingatangi ku0, hukama hwekukwira kwemabhawa nehwemakosha hunogona kusiyana, uye ronga nzira dzekudzivirira kusanzwisisana.
y-m-18-04.material: Huwandu hwemabhuku akatengeswa mwedzi uno pamabhukisitoro ekwedu A ne B hunoratidzwa mu bar graph. Scale yakatwasuka ine mabhuku 80 pazasi chose uye wobva wa85, 90, 95, ne100 mabhuku uchikwira (haitangi pamabhuku 0). Kukwira kwebhawa kunoyerwa kubva pachiratidzo chepasi (mabhuku 80) kusvika pamucheto webhawa. Mucheto webhawa ra A uri pamabhuku 90 uye mucheto webhawa ra B uri pamabhuku 100. Saka bhawa ra B rinoita sekuti rakareba anenge kaviri bhawa ra A.
y-m-18-04.thinking.0: Kutaura maonero anopiwa ne graph kubva pamakosha chaiwo
y-m-18-04.thinking.1: Kuongorora kuti nzvimbo yekutanga ye scale inokanganisa sei kuenzanisa
y-m-18-04.thinking.2: Kugadzira mapeya emakosha anogutsa mamiriro nekukurudzira kuvandudza
y-m-18-04.prereq.0: Kuverenga scale ye bar graph (nhanho ye 4th-grade)
y-m-18-04.s.s1.prompt: Shamwari nhatu dzakatarisa graph iyi uye dzakataura. Sarudza zvirevo zvose zvakarurama.
y-m-18-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa zvakananga nenhamba dzekutengesa dzakanyorwa pa scale kuti chirevo chaJisu chakarurama here.
y-m-18-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti pasi pe scale yakatwasuka ndimabhuku mangani, uye kuti kukwira kwemabhawa kunoyerwa kubva papi.
y-m-18-04.s.s1.o.a: Jisu: “Bhawa ra B rakareba kaviri, saka tinogona kutaura kuti kutengesa kuri kaviri chaizvo.”
y-m-18-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga kukwira kwebhawa sekutengesa pacho. Tarisa scale kuti kukwira kwebhawa kunoyerwa kubva papi.
y-m-18-04.s.s1.o.b: Doyun: “Kana ukaverenga scale, A ndimabhuku 90 uye B ndimabhuku 100. Hazvisi kaviri.”
y-m-18-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa nekuverenga makosha kubva pa scale panzvimbo yemaonero e graph.
y-m-18-04.s.s1.o.c: Raon: “Scale inotangira pamabhuku 80, saka hukama hwekukwira kwemabhawa nehwekutengesa hwakasiyana.”
y-m-18-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakacherekedza kuti nzvimbo yekutanga ye scale inokanganisa kuenzanisa.
y-m-18-04.s.s1.o.d: Seoeun: “Graph pachayo yakashata, saka data iyi haigoni kushandiswa uye inofanira kuongororwa zvakare.”
y-m-18-04.s.s1.r.d: Makosha ari mu graph haana kushata. Zviri nyore kusanzwisisa zvichienderana nekuverenga kwawo, asi data haisi kushata.
y-m-18-04.s.s1.explain: Kukwira kwemabhawa kunoyerwa kubva pamabhuku 80, saka A yakadhirowa yakakwira mabhuku 10 uye B yakakwira mabhuku 20, uye zvinoita sekuti kaviri. Asi kutengesa chaiko, mabhuku 90 nemabhuku 100, hazvisi kaviri. Graph pachayo haina kushata; zviri nyore kusanzwisisa nekuda kwenzvimbo yekutanga ye scale.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.prompt: Mu graph yakadai, ine scale inotangira pamabhuku 80, gadzira mapeya 2 akasiyana ekutengesa apo bhawa ra B rakadhirowa rakareba kaviri bhawa ra A asi kutengesa chaiko kwa B kuri 1.2 nguva ya A kana pasi. (A ne B ndenhamba dzakasikwa dzemabhuku dzakakura kupfuura 80.)
y-m-18-04.s.s2.hint.0: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti kukwira kwebhawa kunoyerwa nekuti kwakakura kupfuura mabhuku 80 zvakadini.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza A, uye uverenge kuti B inofanira kuva mabhuku mangani kuti kukwira kwebhawa ra B kuve kaviri kwe A.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.hint.2: Nemakosha awakasarudza, tarisa iwe pachako kuti kutengesa kwa B ndi nguva dzingani kutengesa kwa A.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.ok.c1: A yakakura kupfuura mabhuku 80 uye zvose ndenhamba dzakasikwa.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.fail.c1: A inofanira kuva huru kupfuura 80 uye zvose zvinofanira kuva nhamba dzakasikwa.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Kukwira kwebhawa ra B, kunoyerwa kubva pachiratidzo chemabhuku 80, kuri kaviri bhawa ra A.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukwira kwebhawa ra B, kunoyerwa kubva pachiratidzo chemabhuku 80, hakusi kaviri kukwira kwebhawa ra A.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Kutengesa kwa B ndi 1.2 nguva ya A kana pasi.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Kutengesa kwa B kwakakura kupfuura 1.2 nguva ya A.
y-m-18-04.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana (A, B)=(85, 90), kukwira kwemabhawa ndimabhuku 5 nemabhuku 10, iyo ndi kaviri, asi kutengesa chaiko kuri anenge 1.06 nguva. Kune (90, 100) ndi anenge 1.11 nguva. Kana scale isingatangi ku0, musiyano mudiki unogona kuoneka mukuru.
y-m-18-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukadhinda graph iyi mu newsletter yechitoro chemabhuku, ungachinja kana kuwedzera sei kuti vaverengi varege kunzwisisa zvisina kururama kuti ‘B yakatengesa kaviri’? Kurudzira nzira imwe kana kupfuura.

y-m-18-04.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti munhu anoona graph kekutanga angatarisa papi kuti awane makosha.

y-m-18-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakatonga nepercentage yakakwira chete. Tarisa kuti vanhu vemhando ipi percentage iyoyo yakabva kwavari.
y-m-18-07.s.s1.explain: Vadzidzi vakawanda vanoda kutamba soccer vanogona kuungana paminda yesoccer. Saka mhedzisiro iyi inogona kuratidza zvinofungwa ne 'vadzidzi vakaungana paminda yesoccer', asi zvakaoma kutaura kuti ndizvo zvinofungwa nechikoro chose.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.prompt: Minseo akachinja nzira uye akadhirowa vadzidzi 36 nelottery yenhamba dzekuuya kubva pandandanda yevadzidzi vese, kuti magiredhi nemakirasi asangane zvakaenzana, uye akavabvunza. Vadzidzi 9 (25%) vakapindura ‘soccer.’ Unotonga sei ikozvino?
y-m-18-07.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa kuti ‘wakabvunzwa ani’ unosiyana sei muongororo mbiri.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira kana vadzidzi 9 chaizvo vaizoti ‘soccer’ kana vadzidzi 36 vakadhirowa zvakare.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.o.a: Iyo 80% yevadzidzi 30 vekutanga yakarurama, uye 25% yevadzidzi 36 vaiye zvino yakaipa.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.r.a: Wakati mhedzisiro imwe yakarurama zvechokwadi uye wakarasa imwe. Tarisa kuti nzira dzeongororo mbiri dzinosiyana sei.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.o.b: Zivisa 52.5%, pakati chaipo pemhedzisiro mbiri, sepercentage yechikoro chose.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.r.b: Wakangosanganisa seti mbiri dzedata dzakaunganidzwa nenzira dzakasiyana. Nekuti maitiro ekusarudza vanhu vekuongorora akasiyana, kuzvisanganisa kunogona kusava nemusoro.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.o.c: Mhedzisiro yevadzidzi 36 iri padyo nechikoro chose, asi hatizivi mutengo chaiwo.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.r.c: Wakasarudza kuti unovimba zvakadini zvichienderana nenzira yeongororo, uye wakaonawo muganhu wekuti vadzidzi 36 havazi chikoro chose zvakare.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.o.d: Vadzidzi 36 vanopfuura 30, saka zivisa se 25% yechikoro chose.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.r.d: Wakasimbisa kuti zvakafanana chaizvo, uchitora huwandu hwevanhu. Kana vanhu vakasiyana vakadhirowa, mhedzisiro inogonawo kusiyana zvishoma.
y-m-18-07.s.s2.explain: Iyo 25% yevadzidzi 36 vakadhirowa zvakaenzana ine mukana wakawanda wekumiririra chikoro chose kupfuura 80% yeongororo yepaminda yesoccer. y-m-18-07.s.s3.model.0: Kubva kukirasi imwe neimwe, ndichadhirowa vadzidzi 3 nelottery yenhamba dzekuuya uye ndichavabvunza, kuti ndibvunze zvakaenzana mumakirasi ese. Kana ndikabvunza mukirasi isati yatanga panzvimbo yepanguva yezororo, handisangane nevadzidzi vanoungana paminda chete.
